summary.text: Alice Emmons is a Democratic member of the Vermont House of Representatives for the Windsor-3 District, a Springfield resident and small-business owner who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her House tenure as beginning in 1983, and she has chaired the Corrections and Institutions Committee.

paragraphs.text: Alice Emmons was born in and lives in Springfield, Vermont, and graduated from Springfield High School.
She earned a B.S. from the University of New Hampshire in 1977.
Her career experience includes owning Lamps and Shades by Alice, and she became a member of the Springfield Board of Civil Authority.

Ballotpedia's committee records list Emmons as chair of the Corrections and Institutions Committee in every session from 2011-2012 through 2023-2024, and as vice chair of the Justice Oversight Committee in the 2019-2020, 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 sessions.
